description_en: Queries the analysis template of an intelligent tagging job
description_zh: 查询智能标签作业的分析模板
name: QuerySmarttagTemplateList

parameters.help_en: The template ID. You can obtain this value from the response of the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/187759.html operation. If you specify this parameter, only the information about the specified template is returned. Otherwise, the information about all templates of the current RAM user is returned
parameters.help_zh: 模板ID，可以从https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/187759.html的返回参数中获取。若指定该参数，则只返回该模板的信息；否则返回当前RAM⽤户所有模板的信息
parameters.name: template_id

AnalyseTypes.description_en:
The analysis type. One or more values may be returned. Valid values: 

ocr: Recognizes tags from text in images.
asr: Recognizes tags from audio speech.
classification: Video classification.
shows: Recognizes shows in videos.
face: Recognizes faces in videos.
role: Recognizes character roles in videos.
object: Recognizes objects in videos.
tvstation: Recognizes TV station logos in videos.
action: Recognizes action events in videos.
emotion: Recognizes facial expressions in videos.
landmark: Recognizes landmarks in videos.
scene: Recognizes scenes in videos.
movieIp: Recognizes movie and TV show IPs in videos.

subtitle: Caption extraction
AnalyseTypes.description_zh:
分析类型，可能返回一个或多个。可取值： 

ocr：从图像⽂字中识别出标签 。
asr：从⾳频语⾳中识别出标签 。
classification：视频分类 。
shows：视频识别节⽬ 。
face：视频识别⼈脸 。
role：视频识别⼈物⻆⾊ 。
object：视频识别物体 。
tvstation：视频识别台标。
action：视频识别动作事件 。
emotion：视频识别表情 。
landmark：视频识别地标 。
scene：视频识别场景。
movieIp：视频识别影视IP。

subtitle：字幕提取功能

FaceCategoryIds.description_en:
The system face library ID. One or more values may be returned. Valid values:

celebrity: celebrity figures.
politician: political figures.
sensitive: sensitive figures
FaceCategoryIds.description_zh:
系统⼈脸库ID，可能返回一个或多个。可取值：

celebrity：明星⼈物。
politician：政治⼈物。
sensitive：敏感⼈物

FaceCustomParamsConfig.description_en:
The parameters of the face algorithm in JSON string format. Currently, the face detection threshold and face recognition threshold are supported. Valid values:

faceDetThreshold: the face detection threshold. Default value: 0.999. This parameter is valid only for unknown face analysis.

faceRegThreshold: the face recognition threshold. Default value: 0.9
FaceCustomParamsConfig.description_zh:
人脸算法的参数，JSON String形式，目前支持人脸检测阈值和人脸识别阈值。取值：

faceDetThreshold：人脸检测阈值，默认阈值0.999，只对陌生人脸分析有效。

faceRegThreshold：人脸识别阈值，默认阈值0.9

Industry.description_en:
The industry. Default value: common. Valid values:

microVideo: short video industry.

common: general industry
Industry.description_zh:
⾏业。默认值：common（通用行业）。可取值：

microVideo：小视频行业。

common：通用行业

IsDefault.description_en:
Indicates whether this is the default template. Valid values:

true: Yes.

false: No
IsDefault.description_zh:
是否为默认模板。可取值：

true：是

false：否

KeywordConfig.description_en:
The keyword tag configuration. The type field specifies the part-of-speech categories. You can select multiple categories separated by commas (,). The following categories are available:

name: person name

location: place name

organization: organization name

other: other

If KeywordConfig is not specified, or the Keyword field is invalid (not a JSON string), or KeywordsConfig does not contain the type field, or the type field is invalid, all keyword types are returned by default
KeywordConfig.description_zh:
关键词标签配置。type代表词性类别选择，可多选，用半角逗号（,）分隔，当前有以下类别：

name：人名

location：地名

organization：机构名

other：其他

当不传KeywordConfig时或者Keyword字段非法（不为JSON String）或者KeywordsConfig不包含type字段或者type字段非法时默认返回type全部类型关键词

KnowledgeConfig.description_en:
In intelligent tagging 2.0 and 2.0-custom modes, specifies the scope of knowledge graph fields returned in the tag results. For more information about knowledge graph fields, see [Knowledge graph fields of intelligent tagging jobs]（https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/356383.html）. If this parameter is not specified, or knowledgeConfig is empty, or knowledgeConfig is invalid (not a JSON string), the following fields are returned by default:

movie:

    - name: IP name

    - alias: IP alias
    - chnl: category
    - genre: genre
    - country: production country or region
    - language: language
    - releaseYear: release year

music:

    - songName: song name
    - artistName: artist name
    - artistArea: artist region (Chinese/Japanese/Korean/Western/Other)
    - albumName: album name

person:

    - name: name
    - gender: gender
    - citizenship: citizenship
    - occupation: occupation
    - classification: type
    - nationality: ethnicity
    - birthPlace: birthplace
    - birthDate: date of birth

landmark
    - name: name
    - nameEn: English name
    - description: description
    - address: address

item

    - brandName: brand
    - finegrainName: fine-grained description
KnowledgeConfig.description_zh:
智能标签2.0和2.0-custom模式下，设置返回标签结果中识别到知识图谱信息字段范围。更多知识图谱信息请参见[智能标签作业知识图谱字段说明]（https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/356383.html）。不填写或者knowledgeConfig为空或者knowledgeConfig非法（不为JSON String）时，默认输出以下字段：

movie：

    - name：IP名称

    - alias：IP别名
    - chnl：类别
    - genre：类型
    - country：制片国家、地区
    - language：语言
    -  releaseYear：发布年份

music：

    - songName：歌曲名称
    - artistName：歌手姓名
    - artistArea：歌手所属地区，华语/日本/韩国/欧美/其他
    - albumName：专辑名称

person：

    - name：姓名
    - gender：性别
    - citizenship：国籍
    -  occupation：职业
    - classification：类型
    - nationality：民族
    - birthPlace：出生地
    - birthDate：出生日期

landmark
    - name：名称
    - nameEn：英文名
    - description：描述
    - address：地址

item

    - brandName：品牌
    - finegrainName：细粒度描述

LabelType.description_en:
The labeling type. Default value: auto. Valid values:

auto: machine labeling.

hmi: human-machine collaboration

LabelVersion.description_en:
The intelligent tagging version. Default value: "1.0". Valid values:

1.0: intelligent tagging 1.0.

2.0: intelligent tagging 2.0 (CPV tags).

2.0-custom: intelligent tagging 2.0-custom (CPV tag custom model)
LabelVersion.description_zh:
指定智能标签版本，默认为"1.0"。可取值：

1.0：智能标签1.0，

2.0：智能标签2.0（CPV标签）

2.0-custom：智能标签2.0-custom（CPV标签定制模型）
